name: ax-tax-scope
description: Establish the tax-law boundary for Åland (Aland Islands) before using Finnish tax guides. Use for Aland Islands tax, Åland municipal income tax, the Finnish VAT tax border, services supplied to or from Åland, regional business rights and property acquisitions. This 2026 router distinguishes national legislation, regional exceptions and prospective amendments, and names the topical companion each question needs. It supplies scope classifications and the evidence needed for a reviewing practitioner. It does not compute a taxpayer's liability, establish registration or filing deadlines, or supply a complete country pack. Income tax is in ax-income-tax.
